Daily Quiz.question: ১) The play 'Antony and Cleopatra' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist.
- He was born on 23 April, 1564 AD and died on 23 April, 1616 AD.
- His Birth place is Stratford Avon.
- He is often called the bard of Avon.
- Shakespearean period belongs to 1590-1616.
- He wrote 37 plays and 154 sonnets.
- His famous tragedies:
• Antony and Cleopatra,
• Hamlet,
• Macbeth,
• Othello,
• King Lear,
• Julius Caesar,
• Romeo and Juliet,
• Titus Andronicus,
• Timon of Athens.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Who is the writer of 'The Spanish Tragedy'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Thomas Kyd is the Father of English Revenge Tragedy.
- His famous play is 'The Spanish Tragedy'.
- It is called Bloody Drama.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Who is the father of modern English Poetry?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Geoffrey Chaucer is the father of modern English Poetry.
• His best writings:
- Canterbury Tales,
- Troilus and Criseyde.
- He is also called Father of English Language, Father of English literature, First Humourist in English Literature, The First great Modernist.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Which period was replete with lyrics and songs?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- The Elizabethan Period is a period of original romanticism.
- This period was replete with lyrics and songs.
- This period is called the Golden age of English literature/Golden Period of English Drama/A nest of singing birds.
- Duration of Elizabethan Period is 1558 to 1603.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) 'Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them' was quoted by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Twelfth Night is a famous comedy by William Shakespeare.
- His famous quotation of this comedy:
• Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them'.
Source: The Oxford Dictionary quotations and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) 'Gorboduc' is the first English ___ by Thomas Norton and Thomas Sackville.
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Gorboduc, the first English tragedy, is written by Thomas Norton and Thomas Sackville.
- Ralph Roister Doister, the first English comedy, is written by Nicholas Udall.
- Pamela, the first novel of English Literature, is written by Samuel Richardson.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who is a 'University Wits'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Elizabethan Period এর একদল Young dramatist and pamphleteers (ক্ষুদ্র পুস্তিকা রচয়িতা) দেরকে University Wits বলা হয়।
- তাঁরা Oxford and Cambridge University এর Scholar/Witty students ছিলেন।
- তাঁরা অনেক বিখ্যাত নাটক রচনা ও মঞ্চস্থ করার মাধ্যমে খ্যাতি অর্জন করেছিলেন।
- University Wits ছিলেন মোট ৭ জন।
- এঁরা হলেনঃ
• Christopher Marlowe,
• Thomas Kyd,
• Robert Greene,
• George Peele,
• Thomas Nashe,
• John Lyly and
• Thomas Lodge.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) The Greatest Cavalier poet is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- The Greatest Cavalier poet is Robert Herrick.
- He is a famous poet of the Caroline Period.
- His famous poems:
• To Daffodils,
• Delight in Disorder,
• The Night Piece of Julia,
• The Litany to the Holy Spirit.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) The poem 'The Canonization' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• John Donne is a Metaphysical Poet.
• He is also called Poet of Love and Religious Poet.
• His famous poems:
- The Good Morrow,
- The Flea,
- The Ecstasy,
- The Sun Rising,
- The Canonization,
- Twicknam Garden,
- For Whom The Bell Tolls etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) 'The Merchant of Venice' is a comedy of William Shakespeare about a-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- 'The Merchant of Venice' is a comedy by William Shakespeare.
- এটি এক ইহুদি সুদখোরের কাহিনী নিয়ে রচিত একটি নাটক।
- ইহুদি সুদখোরের নাম Shylock।
- এই নাটকের অন্যান্য চরিত্রঃ
• Antonio (protagonist),
• Portia (Heroine),
• Bassanio,
• Jessica ইত্যাদি।
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) The poem 'To His Coy Mistress' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Andrew Marvell is an English Metaphysical poet and politician.
- His notable works:
• To His Coy Mistress,
• The Definition of Love,
• The Garden etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who is the Father of English Tragedy?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Christopher Marlowe is the Father of English Drama/Tragedy.
• He is a University wit.
• He is the founder of Blank Verse in English Literature.
• His notable plays:
- The Massacre of Paris,
- Doctor Faustus,
- The Jew of Malta,
- Tamburlaine the Great,
- Edward II,
- Didu, Queen of Carthage etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who wrote the book 'Utopia'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Thomas Moore is a social philosopher, English lawyer, author and statesman.
- He wrote the book 'Utopia'.
- The book 'Utopia' (or Kingdom of Nowhere) was originally written in Latin in 1516.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Who translated 'The Bible' into English from Latin?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- John Wycliffe is called the father of English prose.
- He translated The Bible into English from Latin.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) The author of 'The Unfortunate Traveller' is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Thomas Nashe is a University Wit.
- He wrote the book 'The Unfortunate Traveller'.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) The epic 'The Faerie Queene' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Edmund Spenser is called the poet of poets.
- His notable works:
- The Faerie Queene (Epic),
- the Shepherds Calendar,
- The Ruins of Time.
- His famous sonnet collection is Amoretti.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who wrote the play 'The Alchemist'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Ben Jonson is known as Comedy of manners.
- He wrote in the time when romantic mode of literature was prevalent.
- His notable works:
• Every Man in His Humour,
• Every Man Out of His Humour.
• His comedies are known as 'Comedy of Humors'.
- His famous works :
• The Magnetic Lady,
- Volpone,
- The Silent Woman,
- The Alchemist,
- The Devil is an Ass etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) The play 'As You Like It' which was written by William Shakespeare is a-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist.
• He is mostly known for his plays.
• His notable comedies:
- As You Like It,
- The Tempest,
- The Comedy of Errors,
- Twelfth Night,
- The Taming of The Shrew,
- Mid Summer Night's Dream,
- The Two Gentlemen of Verona,
- The Merry Wives of Windsor,
- The Winter's Tale,
- Cymbeline,
- Pericles, Prince of Tyre,
- The Two Noble Kinsmen,
- Much Ado About Nothing,
- Love's Labour's Lost.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Who is not a 'Metaphysical poet'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Metaphysical Poet of English literature:
- John Donne,
- George Herbert,
- Abraham Cowley,
- Henry Vaughan,
- Andrew Marvell,
- John Cleveland,
- Richard Crashaw
• George Peele is not a metaphysical poet. He is a university wits.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who is the author of 'Sapho and Phao'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- John Lyly is a University Wit.
- His notable works:
• Campaspe,
• Sapho and Phao,
• Midas,
• Euphues etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.
